definitions.prefill_ms: Native duration evaluating only prompt_n uncached tokens, never the full cached prompt.
definitions.prefill_tps: Native prompt_per_second/logged prompt TPS; managed uses actual uncached evaluated_tokens*1000/prompt_ms per observation, not ratio of medians.
definitions.decode_ms: Native predicted_ms / generation_ms / printed eval-time duration.
definitions.decode_tps: Native reported rate, retained verbatim; do not recompute from the printed/output token count.
definitions.prompt_cached_tokens: timings.cache_n / cached_prompt_tokens, preexisting prompt KV reuse, not final cache occupancy.
definitions.prompt_total_tokens: API tokens_evaluated total prompt (evaluated+cached); unavailable for generic app logs.
definitions.predicted_output_tokens: API predicted_n / managed completion_tokens, including first sampled output.
definitions.decode_eval_tokens: Native perf line's PRINTED eval-token count, not an independently measured number of pure timed forward passes. Observed printed count matches API output count; the native reported TPS convention can account one fewer. Managed stderr absent: this printed counter is unavailable, not estimated.
definitions.rate_example: 3072 first-prefix: API/printed count21,423.682ms,reported47.205215tokens/s; rate*duration implies20, not21. Preserve native rate rather than inflate it by dividing21/duration.
definitions.tails: Nearest-rank p95; every field retains n/median/p95/min/max. Durations ms; TPS tokens/s.
definitions.scope: All standalone/app identities, failed and pressure-qualified rows, plus separately labeled attribution texts.

matrix.association_limit: API timing fields belong to their original requests. Native log records are assigned only to phase barriers when total counts match; three-slot completion order is NOT joined to request submission order. Native decode-eval counts are phase distributions, not fabricated per-request joins.
